Commentary.Commentary: Tim Paine's rather defensive captaincy is a major cause for that. When Pakistan were reduced to 57/5, he did not apply the kind of pressure he should have and let the opposition batsmen score freely. It could really cost him and his side. Though, plenty left in this game. Will be interesting to see how his batsmen see off the remaining time before Stumps today with the ball turning and gripping like it is. Should be fun.

The 147-run stand between Zaman and Sarfraz (both of whom missed out on tons) set the tone and it seemed like the hosts would take the game away completely, but an unexpected weapon in Marnus Labuschagne broke that stand and the leggie managed to bag 2 more after that. It helped the visitors to somewhat come back in the game, but those late runs from Yasir Shah saw Pakistan get close to 300, which would disappoint the Australians.

After how the first hour of this opening day panned out, you'd have wondered if they would even get to 200, let alone close to 300. A fine effort from skipper Sarfraz and debutant Zaman to steer their side to safe waters after their top and most of the middle order were torn apart by Nathan Lyon's 4-fer in the morning.

OUT! TIMBER! That seals the deal for Australia. Starc comes charging in and arrows an inswinging yorker on middle, Abbas has no chance of doing anything about it as the stumps are disturbed. PAKISTAN ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 282!
FOUR BYES! Way, way down the leg side, even Paine has no chance to stop it with a full stretch dive. It goes across the fine leg boundary in a jiffy.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Yorker speared in on leg, worked away on the leg side without much trouble.
Good length delivery angling across, Abbas looks to play at it but misses.
Full delivery swinging in from outside off, a mistimed drive from Abbas finds the man at mid off.
And Mitchell Starc will take it immediately.
The second new ball has been taken.
Extremely full on the stumps, dug out back down the track.
Turning away from outside off, on a shorter length, punched away square on the off side for a run.
A single 'round the corner as it's flicked there easily.
A back foot punch from deep inside the crease finds its way to the bowler.
Quicker through the air again, hit back in the bowler's direction.
Quicker and on the stumps, forced towards mid-wicket.
Defends it by coming onto the front foot and seeing it out safely.
SIX! That's a meaty blow! A lot of loop on this as Lyon lands it full outside off, Abbas reaches out to it and launches it over long on for a biggie.
Turning in from around off, Abbas defends it off the front foot.
Fuller from Lyon, defended well from inside the crease.
Full and fast, angling in on leg, goes off the pads behind on the leg side as Hamza misses the slog sweep. A leg bye is taken.
Mir Hamza defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Turns it through the left of short leg and gets a single for doing so.
Remains watchful as he plants his front foot forward and defends.
Quicker through the air, shorter in length, worked off the pads past short leg.
On the fuller side of things again, another defensive shot in response.
Yorker fired in on off, jammed out back down the track.
Pushes it quicker through the air, full on off, pushed off the outer half to gully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Plays for the turn when there is none. Gets beaten past the outside edge as a result.
Brings out the reverse sweep and gets a top edge. Luckily for him, it falls safely in the backward point area. Two taken.
Turning into the batsman, Abbas goes back and defends it with the full face.
Drifting in on middle and off, dug out towards mid on. Single taken.
Tossed up and just around off, Hamza comes onto the front foot and blocks.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Hamza is off the mark in Test cricket. Fuller outside off, he comes forward and pushes it just wide of point for a single.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
Angling across on a fullish length, outside off, play and a miss from Hamza.
Debutant Mir Hamza is the last man in for Pakistan.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Terrific delivery from Mitchell Marsh. Timely blow for Australia. That tried and tested yorker from Marsh. Fires it on leg stump and Shah can't do anything about it. Looks to flick but it goes off his pads and crashes into the stumps behind. He'd have liked to do more, but Yasir has done his job here.
FOUR! Shah making some quick and useful runs here. Pakistan have crossed 260. Short of a length on the stumps, Yasir pulls it hard in front of square leg and finds the fence.
Touch short on leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Classy punch through covers for a brace by Yasir Shah. Ends a 12 run over, a good one for the hosts.

Beaten! Good come back by the leggie as he pulls his length back a little and lands it around off. Shah goes back looking to block it but is beaten as the ball lands, spins and zips past his outside edge.

SIX! WHACK! Flighted ball on off this. Yasir in super attacking mode now as he gets under this one and smacks it straight over the long off fielder for a huge maximum. Very important runs these for Pakistan.
FOUR! Drags it short. Was trying a quicker one may be and errs in length. Yasir Shah gets quickly onto it by rocking back and pulling it through the deep square leg region for a smashing boundary.
Similar ball, Shah this time goes back to punch it to mid off.
Tossed up ball in line with the stump. Yasir prods forward in defense.
Shorter in length angling into Abbas. The right-hander shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
This time Abbas lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Abbas again comes forward to defend this good length ball on off.
Mohammad has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Similar length but on off this time. Abbas waits back in his crease and keeps it out.
Fractionally shorter of a good length, angling into the batsman. Abbas does well to block it out off the back foot.
Mohammad Abbas walks out to bat.
Drinks.

OUT! Lucky this time though! A bit of a rash stroke from Sarfraz but he had to go for it with the lower order at the other end. He was getting tired as well. Tries to whack this tossed up ball on off over the mid off fielder. However, gets the outer half of the bat as the ball goes in the air towards Siddle at extra cover. Peter fumbles it a couple of times but grabs it on the third attempt. The leg spinner is now the leading wicket-taker in this innings with three dismissals to his name.

Unlucky Labuschagne. He gives this a bit more air and keeps it full outside off. Ahmed goes for the drive but gets the outside edge. It flies through the vacant second slip region and the Pakistan captain picks up a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit straighter this one allowing Shah to flick it through the square leg region and go to the other end.
Keeps it very full in line with the stumps. Yasir drives off the inner half to mid on.
Tossed up ball on off, Sarfraz goes down to sweep and gets it thorugh to deep square leg for a single.
Similar ball this but Ahmed tucks it onto the backward square leg region to pick up a single and keep strike. The fielder there dives to stop the single but fumbles and the batsmen cross over.
Bouncer! Sarfraz does well to evade it by getting inside it's line.
Short again and Ahmed is now expecting a bouncer every ball. He stands tall to block it out onto the leg side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shorter in length again this and angling into Ahmed's body. He tries to cut it into the off side but gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
Offline bouncer to start a new over. Starc bangs this one short again. Looks like this is a plan by the bowler to bounce the batsman out. He fires this way down the leg side though.
Flighted again on off, enticing the drive. Shah though blocks it out off the front foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up and in line with the stumps. Shah defends it off the front foot.
Beaten by a peach. Labuschagne lands this flighted ball on off. Shah goes back looking to keep it out but the ball lands and spins past his outside edge. Good leg spin bowling by the youngster.
Very full ball on off, Shah punches this straight back to the bowler.
Well tossed up delivery on off, Yasir looks to drive without getting to the pitch of the ball. The result is a thick outside edge towards the third man region.
Rib-tickler again but well played by Sarfraz as he rides the bounces and blocks this onto the ground.
As expected, Starc again goes for the bouncer. This time though the line is totally wayward as he fires this one way down the leg side.
Sarfraz Ahmed is hit on his elbow. The Pakistan physio is out treating the Pakistan captain. Should be fine to continue, doesn't look serious.

Banged in short again and angling straight at Sarfraz's body. The right-hander comes a bit inside the line looking to block it off. The ball doesn't rise as much as he expected it to and hits him just below his left below. He is in pain and has called the physio out.
Not too short to duck under it but Sarfraz somehow manages to do that. Starc bangs this one short, the ball flies just over his body.
A bit shorter than a good length angling into the body of Shah. Yasir does well to get some bat on it towards square leg to get to the other end.
Bumper! Shah tries to work it on the leg side but has taken his eyes off the ball. His swat misses the ball as it flies behind to Paine.
Taps this to the point region to end the over.
A beauty this from Labuschagne. He lands this flighted delivery full and around off. The well set Pakistan captain looks to block it out but is beaten by the prodigious turn away from him on landing.
Fuller ball on off, allows Yasir to drive it to mid off and take a run.
A bit short this from the leggie, Shah goes back to cut but misses again.
Tossed up ball around off, Yasir comes forward in a solid defense.
Drags his length as he lands this short and on the stumps. Sarfraz is happy to pull it to the man at deep square leg and picks up a single.
A bit shorter this time with an inward shape into Shah. The batsman gives himself a bit of room and plays this with a horizontal bat through the point region for a brace.
Good length ball angling into Yasir's body. Shah stands tall and blocks it out off the back foot.
Very full ball and marginally outside off, Shah goes for the big booming drive but mistimes it to mid off.
A bit too wide of off this as it allows Sarfraz to cut it through point and get off strike.
Similar ball by Starc and an identical shot attempted by Sarfraz. This time the right-hander taps it towards point.
Starc from around the wicket fires in a good length ball around off angling in. Sarfraz tries to cut it but gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
Beaten! Similar to the second delivery of the over. Shah looking to block it gets beaten by the away spin.
This time the cover drives earns him a brace. Yasir reaches out to this fuller and flighted delivery on off. Drives this through covers to get a couple of runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A full ball and a bit outside off, driven to mid off.
Beaten again. Shah tries to defend this tossed up ball on off, gets beaten as the ball lands and zips past Yasir's outside edge.

Umpire's referral on this one and given not out by the third umpire. A full length ball around off, Shah goes for the drive through the off side but gets beaten by the spin. Paine whips the bails off in a flash and appeals for a stumping. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that the batsman is inside his crease.
A bit quicker and shorter this around off, Ahmed goes back to cut it but gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller length ball is driven softly to mid off.
Goes over mid-wicket this time. He gets under this tossed up ball on off and whacks it over the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Swept and it hits Travis Head on the shoulder standing at short leg. Shah goes down and sweep this full ball on off. It hits Head and deflects into the square leg region as the batsmen pick up a run.
Tossed up but on the pads, Sarfraz flicks it into the square leg region to get off strike.
FOUR! Superb cover drive from the Pakistan leggie. He gets to the pitch of this full and slower delivery on off. Leans down and drives this crisply through covers to get off the mark.
A bit short and Shah camps back to punch it through cover-point.
Flighted ball on off, Yasir defends it from within the crease.
Yasir Shah comes in to bat.

OUT! Watta leg break! That is Shane Warne-esque here by Labuschagne. He floats this one a bit more and lands it around off on a fuller length. Asif comes forward looking to play it with a tentative push. The ball lands and spins to take a very faint edge which is taken wonderfully by Paine. The leggie doing the job for the tourists. They are back in the match with a bang.
A bit short on middle and leg, risky shot attempted by Asif as he goes back and opens the bat face to run it towards short third man.
Flighted ball and full on off, Asif blocks from his crease.
Fuller ball outside off is driven through covers for a single.
Attacking the pads this one, it's also a bit fuller. Asif flicks it to square leg.
Tossed up ball on off is dealt with a straight bat and kept out onto the leg side.
Good patience shown by Bilal as he goes back to block this one out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and a bit shorter of full length, Asif tries to cut it through point. Gets an under edge and the ball rolls down to the slip region.
Beaten! Should have put this away. A very short and wide ball outside off, Sarfraz goes for the cut but misses.
Very short this on middle and leg. Asif pulls it through square leg for a single.
Beaten! Labuschagne keeps this a bit shorter and around off. Asif goes back to block it but is beaten by the away spin.
Bilal has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Again a superb drive all along the ground through cover-point for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Sarfraz drives this through covers to get a brace. Continues to put pressure on the Aussie bowlers.
A full and loopy ball to end the over. Asif drives it to mid on.
Fired on the batsman's pads, Bilal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Asif defends it from within the crease.
Very full ball on off, Bilal comes forward and drives it to mid off.
Flighted and full on off, Sarfraz has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Asif lets the ball come to him before flicking it through square leg for a single. Easy work for the batsman, this. Paine has to come up with something new.
Ahmed loses his concentration for a moment and gets beaten. The Pakistan keeper tries to play at a fullish ball outside off. The ball skids on straight to beat his outer edge.
Asif has flicked the ball off his pads. Good running between the wickets to pick up three runs.

FOUR! Smashed over mid-wicket. Bilal goes back to this slower and shorter delivery on off. He pulls this handsomely over mid-wicket for a lovely boundary. Good batting this, putting pressure on the spinner.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Played to the point region by Sarfraz. They pick up a single.

Was that a drop? However, byes given by the umpire. Very difficult though. However, byes given by the umpire. So, not a drop this. Very full and a bit quicker outside off. Bilal tries to drive this through covers but misses as the ball spins away. It flies past the left of the first slip fielder who goes for it but cannot get his hand under it. It goes behind for three byes.
A wristy flick from Asif earns him a single on the last ball of the over.
A bit straighter this one, in line with the stumps. Sarfraz moves inside the line and flicks it to square leg to get off strike.
Not good this from the Aussies. They have a long on in place for the new batsman, he drives this flighted ball towards long on and gets an easy single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sweeps again but this time gets it towards the square leg region to pinch a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Sarfraz goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the front pad but outside the line of off.
Lyon to continue after the Tea break.
Stays in his crease to this flatter delivery around off, taps it towards point.
Tossed up and a bit outside off this, Asif comes forward in a solid defense.

We are all set to get the third and final session underway as the umpires make their way out to the middle, followed by the charged up Aussies. Sarfraz Ahmed and the new batsman, Bilal Asif, stride out to the center with the latter on strike, facing his first ball. Labuschagne will finish his over by bowling the last two remaining deliveries.
... Day 1, Final Session ...

What will no doubt be marked as Pakistan's session will still provide some semblance to the Aussies. The pair of Zaman and Ahmed were motoring along well, scoring 127 runs in the session and looked set. Though, right at the stroke of the break, Marnus Labuschagne came up with an absolute jaffa to dismiss Zaman, thereby stopping him from scoring his maiden Test ton. Tim Paine largely was dormant with his captaincy, but the moment he changed things he got a breakthrough. This wicket might just make him realize what to do and the visitors will look to run through the Pakistan tail. Sarfraz will obviously be the key here and it will all come down to how he plays with the tail to score some more useful runs. Don't go away, play will resume shortly.

OUT! Three reds and Fakhar Zaman is out of here. Finally, Tim Paine shakes things up and gets a wicket as a result. The southpaw misses out on his ton and the 147-run partnership is broken. Labuschagne loops up a leg break on middle, it turns ever so slightly and that's enough to beat the inside edge. He's caught on the front pad and a loud shout goes up. The umpire raises his finger but this time Zaman opts for the review. Replays roll in and show he's gone for all money. Australia go into the break with a smile on their face. TEA ON DAY 1!
Another review. Zaman the man in question but this time he's given out. He takes the DRS and it's over to the TV umpire. Looks out this time. Going to be close.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.

Not out! Zaman is safe as the inside edge comes to his rescue. Floats it up on the stumps, Zaman comes half-forward to block but takes a rap on the pads. Luckily for him though, the ball takes the inside edge first but Australia don't seem to spot it. They opt for the DRS and replays show the involvement of the willow. Australia lose both their reviews now.
DRS taken. It's for an lbw decision against Fakhar Zaman. Is it out? Maybe some inside edge?
Marnus Labuschagne has a change of ends.
Comfortably done. Blocked down a bit square in front of cover-point.
Coming in at first and then straightening up just a shade. Sarfraz looks to defend but it takes the outer half of the bat on the off side.
Full in length on off stump, a punchy block finds short mid-wicket.
Very watchful as he keeps bat and pad close together and blocks it back down the track.
Darted full and outside off, blocked with the full face off the front foot.

FOUR LEG BYES! Angling in on leg, going further down, Sarfraz looks to flick this fine. Does so, but not off the bat. Paine can't stop it and it races away. Marsh and Tim appeal, but to no avail. Always missing leg stump, that.
Mitchell Marsh comes back into the attack.
Eases this tossed up delivery through mid on. Single to end the over.
Loopy and full around off, Fakhar gets low to play the reverse sweep and executes it well through backward point. One run to the total.
Sarfraz goes down the ground, from the other side this time and takes a single to long off.
Drives it sensibly to long on and jogs across.

SIX! First one of the Test. Signs of real aggression from Fakhar after keeping quiet for a while. Sees the flight on the ball so decides to charge out. Gets close to the pitch and smokes it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Well played. Patiently waits for the ball to come to him, backs away and cuts it late down and across the third man fence for a boundary.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Works it away with the wrists in front of square leg for one.
Some drift away as it's landed around off, driven to mid off.
Finds the gap in the covers this time. Drives it through the area and gets to the other end.
A little too full outside off, Ahmed digs it out towards covers.
Marnus Labuschagne on to bowl now.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Driven just wide of mid on for an easy run.
The left-handed opener strides well forward to this and meets it with the full face.
Drifting in from around off, flicked defensively towards mid-wicket. Not quite in the gap on that occasion.
Good running between the wicket. Alert stuff as Sarfraz pushes it in front of covers and both batsmen take off and complete the run with ease.
Slower through the air, full and outside off, defended off the outer half to point.
Dabs it away on the off side. Wants the run but won't get it.
Flighted outside off, Sarfraz drags the sweep and places it through square leg for a single.
Brings his wrists into play as he comes forward and flicks it to mid on.
Spinning in, outside off, Ahmed looks to tap and run after placing it to point but it's too close to the fielder.
Backs away to this delivery sliding in, punched square through point for a run.
Spinning away from around off, blocked off the front foot onto the track.
Some room on offer as it's landed a touch short outside off, punched off the back foot through extra cover for three.
Comes forward to this tossed up delivery and blocks.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and wide, cut away towards sweeper cover for a run.
Flicks it away with the wrists on the leg side.
Too full and not much spin, driven to long off for one.
Spinning away from middle and leg, Fakhar goes deep inside the crease and blocks it down on the leg side.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Defends it solidly by getting right behind the line.
Shorter around off, a hint of turn away and Zaman is quick on his feet to rock back and cut it square through the off side for a brace.
Slider on the stumps, punched down towards mid on.
Zaman is forward to push this to the right of the bowler. Lyon though is quick to react and stop it with a dive.
Full and straight, played back to the bowler from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sarfraz has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sliding in on middle and leg, goes off the pads on the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Goes on the back foot and cuts it square through the off side for a single.
Slower through the air, spinning ever so slightly on off, Ahmed closes the face a bit early and gets a safe leading edge on the off side.
Full on middle, defended solidly.
Some spin for Lyon here as he lands it around off, turns away and beats the outside edge of Zaman's hanging bat.
Similar delivery, same shot. Guarded out well.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Camps back and keeps it out safely.
Minimal spin on offer, on the stumps, Fakhar presents a defensive blade in response.
Is well forward again, another block.
Sarfraz defends it off the front foot and into the track.
Plants his front foot forward and meets it with the full face.
Positions himself well behind the line and blocks with a straight bat.
Worked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full and in line of the stumps, defended rather watchfully.
FOUR! Sarfraz gives the charge and gets the desired result. Dances down, gets close to the pitch and hammers it aerially past mid on for a boundary.
Driven through mid off for a run.
A lot of air on this, close to off, Fakhar with a front foot block.
Works this away to mid-wicket against the spin but finds the fielder.
Looped up on off stump, met with the full face of the bat.
Spinning in from outside off, Ahmed backs a long way away and cuts it late behind square on the off side for a single.
Drives this full delivery to mid on and ends the over with a dot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Too straight in line, Zaman works it off the pads down towards fine leg for a double.
Hangs back this time and blocks.
Comes half-forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Spin into the batsman from around off, driven down the ground to long off for a run.
Zaman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Plays for the turn when there isn't any. Off the edge and down to third man for a single.
Pushes this to the covers from the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Straighter one outside off, Ahmed gets low to sweep but it goes off his gloves and falls square on the off side.
Turning in on middle stump, worked on the leg side from within the crease.
Flicked with a closed face to end the over.
Worked away on the leg side. No run taken.
Keeps bat and pad close together as he sees this out safely.
Comes forward on this occasion as it's landed full, blocked.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Spinning in from off stump, kept out from deep inside the crease.
The 100-run stand is up between these two. Superb fightback from Zaman and Sarfraz. The former rocks onto the back foot and punches it through covers for three runs.
Dabbed away square to point. Won't get any run for it.
Goes with the spin and turns it through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed right up there, blocked towards short mid-wicket.
Not much turn on this occasion. Sarfraz looks to defend and it goes off the edge to third man. A couple of more runs to the total.
Cheeky. Plays this really late. Waits for it and opens the face at the last second to run it down to third man. Two taken.
Turns this with the wrists behind square leg.
Drives the ball straight down the ground. Another dot.
Turns in on the pads, nudged on the leg side. No run taken.
Leans ahead and knocks this full ball through mid off for a run.
Drifting in on middle and off, played out safely from the front foot.
FOUR! What a way to bring your 15th Test fifty. Superb knock from Sarfraz Ahmed. He'll want to make a big one here. Short and wide, he backs away and cuts this past backward point to find the fence.
Jon Holland back on.

Drinks are on the field. Pakistan have come back well in this game via Sarfraz and Zaman. Australia have slightly gone on the defensive, which is allowing the hosts to play risk free. Tim Paine needs to apply more pressure.
Backs away and cuts it late down to third man for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sarfraz has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Way down the leg side, Ahmed looks to flick but misses.
Floats it up there, on the stumps, blocked out.
Quite full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Zaman stands tall and punches this on the up past the cover fielder. A couple of easy runs result.
On the shorter side of things, a straight blade is offered in response.
Back of a length on middle and leg, defended back in the bowler's direction.
Short into the body, Ahmed rides the bounce and pulls it to square leg. Gets to the other end and completes the run.
No ball! Another one. Starc oversteps and bowls it full outside off, it's driven to covers.
Too much width offered, Sarfraz pounces on this with a cut shot. Marnus chases after it and keeps the batsmen to two runs.
A change of bats for Sarfraz Ahmed.
Angling across on a good length, punched from within the crease in front of cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays inside the crease and tamely pushes it away on the off side.
Looped up on off, another tight defense presented in response.
Spinning away from around off, full in length, blocked off the outer half on the off side.
Waits for the ball to come as he goes back and taps it down towards third man. Single collected.
From around the wicket, it's fuller and around leg, spinning in, Sarfraz looks to flick but misses and is caught on the front pad.
Offers a firm punch to the cover fielder to end the over.
Tight defense. Blocked with the full face from within the crease.

In the air and safe! Banged in short and it takes Zaman by surprise. It goes off the top edge as he looks to fend it away and falls safely on the leg side. Had there been a short leg in place, he would have been gone.
Swing and a miss. Full and angling in on leg, Zaman looks to go big on the leg side but instead is rapped on the pads.
On a good length outside off, tapped down in front of point.
Cutting back in from a length, worked down onto the leg side from within the crease.
Dishes this flatter and on his pads. Zaman flicks this through square leg to pick up a single and retain strike.
Beautiful bowling by Lyon. He flights this one up and keeps it full around off. Zaman comes forward looking to defend but the spin on the ball beats his outside edge. The southpaw survives.

A very full ball around leg stump. Zaman goes for the sweep but the length is not ideal for that shot. Gets hit very low on his pads but the ball is sliding down the leg side. Aussie go up in a half-hearted appeal.
Tossed up on off, Zaman comes forward in defense.
Zaman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Still standing way outside leg is the Pakistan skipper. Flighted ball on off, Sarfraz goes on the back foot and punches it through covers for a single.
Bouncer by Starc. The southpaw ducks under it.
Fast and full around off, Zaman drives this gently to covers.
No ball. The tall left-hand pacer oversteps. Fires it into Fakhar on a fuller length around middle. Zaman drives it to mid on.

FOUR! Hammered! You cannot bowl there to this left-hander. He will smack you each time. A bit short this outside off. Zaman takes full toll of it as he cracks it through covers off the back foot for a superb boundary.
Fakhar Zaman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and fast angling into the southpaw. Zaman tries to flick it but gets beaten to get rapped on the pads. Drifting down the leg easily this.
Classy from the skipper. Starc floats this one on a good length around off, angling across the batsman. Sarfraz plays a classy cover drive on the up, finds the gap at covers and gets three for it.
Mitchell Starc comes back into the attack.

Goes down to sweep this very full ball on off. Connects well but unfortunately hits the fielder at short leg. However, fortunately for the Pakistan skipper, the ball does not lob into the hands of a fielder.
A bit flatter on the middle and leg stump line. Sarfraz looks to flick it but gets a faint inside edge onto his pads and down onto the ground.
A bit shorter this on off, Zaman punches it through covers to pick up another run.
The southpaw has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit short this, Zaman punches it through covers.
A good start for the hosts after Lunch. Sarfraz goes back to this shorter length delivery outside off, opens his bat face and runs it towards third man to get off strike.

FOUR! Whack! Watta drive! A full pitch ball around off this by Siddle. Looking for some purchase off the surface but there ain't any for the pacer. Zaman leans forward and drives superbly through covers for a wonderful boundary.
The southpaw  picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Zaman has been struck on the pads as he looks to play that off the front foot. However, he was rapped way outside the line of the off stump.
Marginally shorter in length on the stumps, the southpaw keeps it out easily off his back foot. Not much bounce or zip off the surface for the Aussie pacer here.
Drives but finds the fielder at point. A good length ball this and a bit outside off, Zaman square drives this, a bit on the up, straight to point.
Fires this length ball on Sarfraz's pads. The Pakistan skipper flicks it through square leg to pick up a single.
A bit slower and full on off, Nathan gives this a bit more air enticing the batsman into a loose shot. The opener though drives it neatly to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit shorter in length outside off, Zaman cuts it to point.
Flatter and fuller on off, Zaman has driven it straight down the ground.

Interesting from the Pakistan captain. Sarfraz takes his guard around a foot outside his leg stump. Lyon flights this one on off, Sarfraz walks in and works it with the spin through mid-wicket to get off strike.
A bit flatter on off, Sarfraz blocks coming forward.
Good length ball on middle and off from around the wicket. Zaman pushes it towards mid on.
Bouncer from Siddle. Zaman leans behind to let it go.
Shorter in length a bit outside off. Fakhar does well to ride the bounce and play it through the third man region for a brace.
Bat twisted in the hands of the southpaw. Zaman tries to drive a good length ball on off straight down the ground. The ball takes the inner half of the bat as the ball rolls to mid on.
Bouncer! The left-hander ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
A bit fuller this and is driven straight to mid on by Fakhar.
No ball! Siddle from around the wicket, oversteps. Keeps this on a good length around off and angling into the southpaw. Zaman blocks it out off the back foot.
Tossed up again on off, Sarfraz is happy to prod forward in a solid defense.
Sarfraz has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted ball on off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up ball attacking the stumps, worked into the mid-wicket region from within the crease by Fakhar to get a run.
From around the wicket, it's turning away from around off, blocked off the back foot.
Short and flat outside off, cut away through the gap on the off side for three good runs.
Similar ball and a similar shot by the Pakistan captain as he punches this one a bit harder through covers. The batsmen get three this time.
A bit on the the shorter side this, Ahmed punches this through covers to pick up a brace.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Third of the over and Pakistan won't mind how they come as long as they come. This is turning out to be a good over for the hosts. Siddle is a bit unlucky here though as he dishes out a good length ball outside off. Sarfraz goes to play at it but gets a thick outside edge down to the third man fence for the third boundary of the over. The 50-run stand comes up between these two in no time.
Marginally short of a good length on off, Ahmed blocks it off the back foot.

FOUR! Two in two. Siddle errs in line this time and dishes out this delivery down the leg side. Sarfraz manages to nudge it as the nut races down fine onto the leg side for the second boundary in a row.

FOUR! Deft touch! Fires a short of a good length ball outside off, Sarfraz keeps his eyes on the ball till the very end, opens his bat face and glides it through the gully region for a boundary. Smart batting by the Pakistan skipper.

Goes down to sweep this full ball on off, connects well. However, the ball hits the short leg fielder flush on the helmet. Labuschagne there is brave enough to stand still as the ball deflects off his helmet towards the short fine leg fielder and the pair takes a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up around off, Sarfraz has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit short this, tapped to point by Ahmed.
FOUR! Similar ball, similar shot attempted and this time he gets it bang on. Dances down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and whacks it over mid-wicket for a handsome boundary.

Counter-attack on display. Sarfraz Ahmed showing some positive intent by skipping down the track to this tossed up ball on off. He tries to heave it over the mid-wicket region but mistimes it. However, the connection is good enough to get him a brace.
Fuller and in line with the stumps, driven crisply to mid on.
A bit shorter and outside off, Zaman pats it into the point region.
A bit full this and angling into Zaman. The opener looks to flick it but misses to get rapped on the pads. Going down leg this one.
Stays within his crease does the southpaw and defends this length ball around off with a straight bat.
Better from Siddle as he lands this on a good length around off. Sarfraz blocks it into the vacant cover region to get off strike.
A bit fuller and attacking the stumps, Zaman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
The short of a length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side by the southpaw. That's an excellent chase by the fielder. They've managed to run three.
Zaman has punched that ball through the off side.

Fifty on debut for the impressive southpaw! Again spots the short ball quickly, Zaman goes back and punches this through covers to get a brace. He gets to his maiden Test half ton. Very good innings by the debutant but he will now look to be out there as long as possible.
Flatter and quicker on off, Zaman blocks it off from within the crease.
Goes back and cuts this shortish delivery through cover-point. They run three.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.
Nathan Lyon to continue post the break.

We are back for the post Lunch session as the umpires and the Aussies make their way to the middle. The Pakistan pair of Fakhar Zaman and Sarfraz Ahmed also stride out to the center with the latter taking strike.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

The first session of this 2nd Test has been dominated by Australia or should I say, by Nathan Lyon. The offie has had a dream start to this match as he has managed to dismiss four Pakistan batsmen giving away just 12 runs in his 7 overs. After Mohammad Hafeez's unfortunate dismissal, the pair of Fakhar Zaman and Azhar Ali built a 52-run stand to get the innings back on track. However, soon after, the hosts were simply demolished by Lyon as he took four wickets, also barely missing his hat-trick. Pakistan now find themselves in a deep hole and their well-set opener, Zaman, playing on 49 along with his skipper Sarfraz Ahmed will try to rebuild the innings after the break. Australia and Lyon will look to make further inroads and wrap up the first innings as soon as possible. Join us on the other side of the Lunch break for all the action.

FOUR! Cracked! The last ball before the break is also not spared by this attacking southpaw. He will score every opportunity he gets. Rocks back and across to this shorter delivery outside off. Zaman punches it hard through the cover region and the man in the deep has no chance to stop it. That's LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Tossed up on middle and off, Sarfraz flicks it away with a wristy shot to mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flighted and fuller again on off, driven towards the mid on region and they run a single.
Tossed up on off, comes forward to flick it into the mid-wicket region.

FOUR! Shot! Short again outside off this time, Zaman showing some good form as he rocks back quickly to punch it hard through the cover-point region for a cracking boundary. Good counter-attack by Zaman.
Flatter and shorter than full length, blocked off the back foot by Zaman.
Short again, punched down to long off for a single.
FOUR! That will relieve a little bit of pressure. Short and wide outside off, Zaman camps back and cracks it through the covers for a boundary.
Spinning away from outside off, takes the edge and goes past the diving slip fielder. A couple results.
Uses the angle into him and works it away on the leg side.
Comes forward to this fuller ball and defends it out.
Drifting in from around the wicket, Zaman is caught on the pads as he tries to play at it.
Ahmed has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sarfraz lunges forward and drives this flighted and full ball to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted and full again on off, Sarfraz does well to drive this through covers to pick up a brace.
A loopy ball on off this, driven to covers by the Pakistan skipper.
A flighted ball on off, Ahmed comes forward in a tight defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit shorter this on off, Zaman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, Zaman has flicked the ball off his pads.

SAFE! The new rule has saved the southpaw. Sarfraz punches this into the cover region and takes off. Zaman is a bit slow starting but responds. The fielder at covers picks it and throws it to Paine who whips the bails off and Zaman is diving to get back into his crease. The umpires go upstairs to see the replays and decide on the run out. Replays show that Zaman drags his bat inside the crease and then the bat bounces up. However, as per the new rule if the bat or batsman has once come inside the crease then he is not out even if the bat bounces again when the bails are taken off. Close call this.
Third umpire called for a run out at the striker's end. The batsman in question is Fakhar Zaman.
Tossed up ball on off, Ahmed defends it coming right forward.

Sharp turn for Lyon. Every ball from this offie is having the batsmen under pressure. Tossed up ball on off, Sarfraz looking to defend it off the front foot gets an inside edge onto his pads. Lots of oohs and aahs around the pitch.
Once again positions himself behind the line and defends.
Zaman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Worked away on the leg side for no run.
Comes forward to block but wears it on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turning in on middle and leg, catches Zaman on the pads as he looks to defend.
Full in line of the stumps, kept out off the front foot. End of another terrific over from Nathan Lyon.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed to bat next.

OUT! Oh, dear! What is happening here? Nathan Lyon has already bagged a 4-fer and he's not even finished 5 overs yet. Absolutely unbelievable what's going on at the moment. A poor shot by Babar as well to be honest. Lyon loops it up outside off, Azam comes out to play the expansive drive and leaves a big gap between bat and pad. It goes right through the gate and disturbs the furniture behind. Pakistan are in a real slump now. Lyon now is the 4th highest wicket-taker for Australia in Test cricket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Babar Azam is the next man in.

OUT! There's a spike on Ultra Edge and the on-field call has to be overturned. Lyon on fire here. He tosses this up on middle and off, it turns in as Shafiq looks to defend off the front foot. It goes off the pad and Labuschagne at short leg takes it. The Australians think there's an inside edge as well and they appeal. Umpire S Ravi is unmoved. So, the DRS has been taken and it goes to the third umpire. Replays show there is indeed an edge and Asad has to walk back.
The review is taken. For a bat-pad against Asad Shafiq. The Aussies look confident. Let's see what the TV umpire thinks...
Loopy and full on middle and off, Shafiq comes forward and keeps it out.
Driven to mid off along the turf. Dot ball to end the over.
Gets his front leg out of the way and defends it from the front foot.
Goes to the other side this time. Works it away on the leg side for nothing.
Flights this one up on off, blocked off the front foot on the off side.
Darts this across on a shorter length and it keeps a little low, Zaman goes back to cut but gets beaten.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Asad Shafiq is the new man in.

OUT! Two in two for Nathan Lyon! The turning point of the game? The momentum is surely in Australia's favour now. Switches to around the wicket and tosses the off break around off, Sohail comes forward to push it away and he can't keep it down. Hands a sharp catch to Travis Head at silly point, who takes it well. This is a big wicket for the tourists.
Haris Sohail, the man in form, comes in to bat.

OUT! GONE! Caught and bowled. Lyon strikes and brings an end to Azhar Ali's stay in the middle. Soft dismissal, really. Short, flat and spinning in from outside off, Azhar Ali comes out and punches it uppishly right back to the bowler. It goes off the inside half and Lyon takes a simple catch. With this wicket, Lyon becomes the 5th highest wicket-taker for Australia in Tests.
Comes forward and keeps it out off the front foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Edged and safe! Quicker one outside off, takes the outside edge of Zaman's bat and goes past first slip. Two runs taken and that's the 50-run stand up between these two.
Looped up on middle and off, Azhar gets low and sweeps it away on the leg side for a single.
Zaman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Dropped! Will that prove costly for the Kangaroos? Zaman skips down the track to this tossed up ball on middle and off. The southpaw flicks it uppishly straight to the man at short mid-wicket. Marnus Labuschagne stationed there tries to catch it with both hands around 6 inches above the ground. The ball hits his palms and drops out. The youngster cannot believe it. An unbelievable catch to dismiss Hafeez and a simple catch dropped.

Lovely ball this from Jon. He gives it a bit more air but lands it a bit shorter than full length. Zaman comes forward looking to keep it out but the ball spins in sharply. Beats his inside edge and raps him on his back foot and goes to first slip. The Aussies go up in an appeal but not out given. They are not confident enough to go for the DRS and rightly so.
On the pads of the southpaw, Zaman flicks it to deep square leg to come back for the second.
A bit slower and shorter this outside off, Zaman cuts it through point to get a brace.
Tossed up ball on off, Zaman lunges forward and defends.
Jon Holland now to roll his arm over.
A bit shorter this, worked into the square leg region off the back foot by Ali.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball around off, Ali goes for the flick but misses to get rapped on the pads. Not out as it's missing leg easily.
Tossed up ball on off, Ali works it down the leg side.

Wild shot, but Ali is lucky to get an inside edge onto the ground. Azhar sees the flighted ball outside off and goes for the slog sweep over mid-wicket. The ball spins, keeps a bit low and takes the inside edge to roll towards square leg.
Better from Marsh and better from Zaman. Marsh keeps it full around off. Zaman lunges forward and defends with a straight bat.
Errs in line and fires it on Zaman's pads. The southpaw flicks it into the mid-wicket region to pick up another couple.
Similar ball this around off. Zaman comes forward in a solid defense.
Zaman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bouncer and angling into the body of Zaman. The southpaw does well to pull it down and to deep square leg for a brace.

Streaky! Marsh has his hands on his head. Lands this full length delivery on off, Azhar looking to play it straight down the ground, plays a bit inside the line. The ball hits the outer half of the bat and rolls into the cover region as the batsmen take a run.
Defended off the back foot by the southpaw.
Zaman kneels down and sweeps this full ball around the middle and leg stump straight to the man at backward short leg.
Slower and a bit shorter around off, Zaman blocks it off the back foot.
Zaman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten! Flighted ball on off this from Nathan. Gives it a rip as the ball lands and spins sharply beating Zaman's forward defense.
Tossed up on off, Zaman pushes this back to the bowler. Encouraging signs for the offie.
Lovely delivery! Marsh ends his over with a peach. Lands it on a good length just outside off. The ball hits the deck and nips back in to beat Ali's inside edge.
Well played by Ali. Marsh bangs it short around off. The ball rises onto Ali who does well to stand tall, ride the bounce and tap it into the cover region to get a brace. Good batting by Ali.
Fuller and straighter on off, Ali drives it to mid on.
A bit shorter in length this angling into Zaman's body. The southpaw, a bit awkwardly, nudges it into the mid-wicket region to get off strike.
A bit fuller in length this on off, Zaman drives crisply to mid on.
Keeps it tight, Mitch Marsh. Lands it on a good length around off, angling across the southpaw. Zaman pushes it back to Marsh off the front foot.
Tossed up attacking the stumps, Ali prods forward in defense.
Ali has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Azhar leans forward and across. Works this full ball on off into the mid-wicket region.
Flighted and full on off, Ali pushes this back to Lyon.
Similar ball but this time Ali leaves it alone.
Starts with a tossed up ball wide outside off. Azhar comes forward to defend it.
Nathan Lyon comes into the attack. Will be interesting to see how much purchase he will get from this first day surface.
Zaman prods forward again to defend it onto the ground.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good front foot defense by Ali, the ball rolls into the cover region and the pair take a quick single.

Jaffa! This will encourage the medium pacer. Marsh lands this a bit shorter than a good length and slightly wide of off. Azhar looks to play at it due to the angle but is beaten as the nut deviates away from him on landing. Marsh can be dangerous as he comes up with such deliveries every now and then.
Good shot this by Zaman. He gets on the front foot and smashes this length ball straight past the bowler. The fielder at mid on does well to chase it down and keep the batsmen to three.
Marsh bangs it in short, Zaman is patient enough to duck under it.

Drinks. Decent start by Pakistan after electing to bat first, however, they would have been happy if Hafeez would have still been there. The opener was a bit unlucky to be caught at short leg off a perfect flick shot. Pakistan would now look to build a strong partnership and go to Lunch without any further damage. Australia on the flip side, will look to get into the Pakistan middle and lower-middle order as soon as possible.
On the pads again but this time it's the southpaw. May be the right-hand left-hand combo has done the trick. Zaman flicks it into the leg side to take a run.
Bit straighter in line, drifting onto the batsman's pads. Ali leans across to flick it into the square leg region to go take a single.
Ali has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Classy! Just marginally short of a good length and a bit outside off. Azhar opens his bat face perfectly and gets superb timing on it as it races through the backward point region for a sweet boundary.
A good length ball this on off, Azhar comes forward to defend it solidly.
Ali shoulders arms to let that one through.
Azhar flicks this length ball angling into his pads into the mid-wicket region. Crosses over to the other end to retain strike.
Bouncer pulled. Zaman seeing the length quickly rocks back and swivels to pull this to deep square leg. Gets a single for it.
A bit short attacking the stumps, Zaman flicks it away with a wristy shot into the square leg region.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A full ball on off, driven to mid off.
Zaman shoulders arms to let that one through.

No ball. But a pretty tight call though. A super ball to start by Marsh except that he has just about overstepped. A good length ball from over the wicket. Lands and nips back in to beats Zaman's inside edge. It almost cut the southpaw in half.
Mitchell Marsh comes into the attack.
A good ball and a solid back foot defense with a straight bat to end a testing over by Siddle.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit shorter of a good length, angling into Azhar. He flicks it to square leg.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Azhar does well to play that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very good running by the batsmen. Zaman just taps this good length ball into the cover region and takes off. His partner gives him a good quick response and they steal a quick single.

FOUR! Stand and deliver. Zaman stands tall to this short of a length ball just outside off and slashes it hard. The ball takes a thick outside edge to fly over the slip cordon for a boundary. Good counter-attacking batting by the southpaw, this.
FOUR! Wrong line and a delicate touch. Starc dishes this full length ball on Ali's pads. Azhar just delicately glances it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Errs in line Starc. Fires it wide down the leg side, Azhar leaves it alone.
Defended off the back foot by Ali.
Rib-tickler again, the southpaw this time swivels well to pull it down to deep fine leg for a single.
Wide of off, Zaman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Super cut! Fractionally short and wide of off. Zaman pounces on it and upper cuts it over the gully region for a smashing boundary.

Very close leave again. That is some intense Test cricket. Siddle keeps it close to the off stump, angling into Azhar. He leaves it and the nut goes past almost shaving the off stump. At the end, well left!
On a good length and a bit too wide outside off, Azhar watchfully leaves.
Some bounce and height on this. This almost goes over the off stump. It is on a good length outside off. It nips back in sharply and goes over the off pole. Close leave again.
Similar ball to the first one, easier for the right-hander to shoulder arms.
Close! That one came back sharply and almost kisses the off stump before going into Paine's mitts. You can say a good leave now, but that was close.
Good bounce and carry on offer here. Siddle keeps it marginally shorter than a good length just outside off. Azhar does not flirt with it.
Some chin music for the batsman, the southpaw lets that bouncer through to Paine.
Ill-directed bouncer! Starc bangs this in short but gets his angle completely wrong as it strays down leg. Paine does well to swiftly move to his right to pouch it.
Full and on off, Zaman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full again, almost a yorker. Dug out with a straight bat by Zaman. Good pace being generated by the left-hand quick.
Wide of off, Zaman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! SHOT! Cracking straight drive by Zaman. Very full ball attacking the stumps. Starc looking for some non-existent swing. Zaman punches it straight for a sweet boundary.
This one lands a bit shorter of a length outside off, Azhar again looks to block it off the front foot but gets the inner half of the bat towards square leg.
On a good length around off, defended off the front foot by Azhar.
Ali has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Inside edge onto his pad and onto the ground. Azhar lunges forward to this good length ball on off. It lands and nips back in to get the inside edge. Hits his pads before rolling down towards covers.
A bit short and outside off, Azhar watchfully lets it go past him.
Good length ball in the corridor around the off pole, comes forward in a solid defense.
Wide down the leg side, no trouble at all for the southpaw to leave it alone.
Zaman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A bit short of a good length angling into Zaman, the southpaw looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
A bit wide of off this. Zaman again looks to play at it tentatively but again is beaten by the pace and extra bounce.
FOUR BYES! Strays way down leg and rising as well, Paine tries to grab it by diving to his right but fumbles and concedes a boundary.

Beaten! Peach from Starc to start off the new over. Really good carry on that one. Zaman is a bit loose. On a good length just outside off, Zaman did not need to play at it but still tries to get bat on ball. The ball took off and beats Zaman's outside edge.

Not out! Big inside edge on that. Poor review to be honest. Siddle comes steaming in and lands it on a length just outside off, Azhar Ali is half-forward to defend and the ball hits the front pad. Loud shout which is turned down. It's taken upstairs after a brief chat as Siddle feels the batsman is out. Paine responds and signals the 'T'. Replays, however, show there is an inside edge. So a good decision from the umpire.
The DRS has been taken quickly. It's for an lbw decision against Azhar Ali. Siddle thinks he has his man. Inside edge to the naked eye. Let's see...
Touch full around off, kept out off the front foot and into the turf.
Touch short, on the stumps, pulled away into the leg side for a single.
Comes forward to this fuller length ball and blocks.
Just ahead of a length, on off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Attacks the stumps by pitching it full, Zaman defends it back down the track.
Azhar Ali walks in at no.3.

OUT! That's just stuck! Wow. What a catch. Superb stuff from Marnus Labuschagne. Australia strike early. Starc bowls this full on the pads, Hafeez flicks this aerially and it's hit hard. Labuschagne, however, positioned there reacts quickly as the ball is hit to him. It bounces off his left groin, then goes off the inside of his right knee and he manages to gobble it up falling down before the ball touches the ground. Replays confirm the same. Very well done.

Mohammad Hafeez has been caught out. Marnus Labuschagne has taken an absolute blinder at short leg from the looks of it. The umpire wants to make sure though if it's taken cleanly so it's taken upstairs. The soft signal is out.
Keeps it short again and makes it go away from the batsman, it's left alone.

The physio is out to have a look at Hafeez. The doesn't seem to be looking at the thumb, which is a good sign. He shoulder is the issue, which is definitely hurting. The magic spray is out and it's being treated. Should be fine to continue from the looks of it.

Scorcher! A searing delivery from Mitchell Starc as he bangs this in short and bangs it hard. Takes Hafeez by surprise who was expecting a full ball. He goes back, can't play at it and it whacks him on the right shoulder, after brushing his thumb.
Fraction straight in line, worked down on the leg side for nothing.

FOUR! Not in full control at all, but he gets a boundary for it. Shaping away from a back of a length around off, Hafeez gets it off the outer half and past the diving gully fielder to find the fence.
Loose from Hafeez. Short and wide, a nothing delivery, Hafeez should have left it but he goes after it and almost nicks it behind.
Angling across and holding its line, good length delivery, pushed defensively down in front of point.
A little bit of shape back from Siddle as it lands on middle and off, Zaman goes hard at it and drives it to mid on.
Seaming away from outside off, no shot offered from the southpaw.
Keeps it full once more, blocked out with the full face of the bat.
Off the inner half. Zaman looks to drive this full delivery but manages to only mistime it to the left of the bowler.
Full ball attacking the off stump, played back from the front foot.
Peter Siddle will share the new ball with Starc. He has two slips and a gully in place.
Full delivery quite close to off, coming in, Hafeez comes forward and mistimes the drive off the inner half back down the track.
Short of a length outside off, left alone once more.
Good line and good carry on that. Starc lands it on a fuller length outside off and it zips off the deck, Tim Paine behind the stumps collects it at a good height.
Fires it well wide outside off, moving away, Hafeez has nothing to do with it.
First runs in Test cricket for Fakhar Zaman. Full in length and outside off, he pushes it through the covers and takes a single to get going.
Low full toss on the stumps, Zaman drives it back down towards mid on.

We are ready to begin. Fakhar Zaman will take strike and he is partnered by Mohammad Hafeez. Mitchell Starc as always to take the new ball first up. He has three slips and a gully in place. Here we go..
Team Changes - While Australia are unchanged, Pakistan have two changes and both are debutants. Fakhar Zaman and Mir Hamza come in for the injured Imam-ul-Haq and Wahab Riaz.
TOSS - Pakistan win the toss and elect to bat first!

Pakistan will be feeling the heat, both figuratively and literally. Having victory elude them, from the position they were in, will have raised questions over Sarfraz' captaincy more than anything else. They threw everything at the Kangaroos, but just couldn't find a crack anywhere. More will be expected of Yasir Shah this time around, as the hosts will hope he can scalp heads like he usually does. Plenty to look forward to. Stay tuned for all the updates.

Amidst all the tensions surrounding Australian cricket since the last passage of time, the gruelling contest in Dubai, where the visitors managed to provide a resolute resistance, the draw would be very welcome in the Australian camp. Pakistan were on the verge of a thumping victory, but Usman Khawaja stood tall in between that.
